title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-05
lineage: MSR> CASS> DAT> CDR> EAC> FLAC
source: Soundboard (except where patched with low gen AUD as noted)

ai_review.summary: Fair audience recording of a solid June 5‑1970 Fillmore West show featuring jam‑heavy Saint Stephen, Easy Wind and Man’s World
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its energetic set – Saint Stephen is fully jammed out and the rare pairing of Easy Wind with Man’s World delights listeners. The recording is an audience capture that suffers from occasional sound‑board glitches and “aud patches,” but remains listenable, especially after a bit of EQ tweaking.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical highlights (70% weight) offset by noted recording imperfections (30% weight), yielding an overall rating in the high‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners report occasional sound‑guy mishaps, audible patches and uneven levels, but the audience ambience is captured and the tape remains enjoyable with EQ adjustments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The June 5 show blends electric power with acoustic moments from surrounding dates, delivering a well‑paced set that builds to a jam‑rich Saint Stephen and closes with the rare Easy Wind/Man’s World pairing.
